subject: Re: PilotPrompt x Redwood — co-eng sprint for tracing + prompt-tooling
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@pilotprompt.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: partners@pilotprompt.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PilotPrompt x Redwood — proposal for a bilateral co-eng sprint

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking a quick intro last week. PilotPrompt builds developer-focused prompt observability and reusable prompt-templates that many ISVs pair with LangChain/LlamaIndex SDKs. We're seeing a lot of overlap in how we and Redwood instrument prompt flows and trace cross-request context, and we'd like to propose a short bilateral co-eng (2-week) sprint to: 

- validate end-to-end tracing between PilotPrompt SDKs and Redwood's runtime/kernels
- add a thin instrumentation shim for LlamaIndex/LangChain wrappers so traces surface in Redwood Console
- prototype prompt-quality hooks (structured prompt metadata, regen triggers) that feed into your Optimize pipeline

I've attached a one-pager scoping_agenda (PilotPrompt_Redwood_scoping_agenda.pdf) and a lightweight roster. We can run a 60-minute kickoff to align on acceptance criteria and timeline. Proposed windows next week (PST): Tue 3/14 10:00, Wed 3/15 11:30, Thu 3/16 14:00.

Also noting we have a public repo with a reference adapter: https://github.com/pilotprompt/pp-redwood-integration — it's rough but useful for tech teams.

Quick questions for planning:
1) Are you OK with a 2-week pilot that targets hosted + dedicated deployments?
2) Any specific security/compliance checklist you need before we share staging keys?

Cheers,
Alice Park
Head of Partnerships | PilotPrompt
[Attachment: PilotPrompt_Redwood_scoping_agenda.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: pilotprompt_roster.csv (csv)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alice Park <alice@pilotprompt.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:03:24 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotPrompt x Redwood — proposal for a bilateral co-eng sprint

Thanks Alice — really clear and timely. Looping in Marissa (partner lead) and Karthik (runtime/tracing) to scope the tech and commercial side.

Quick responses to your questions:
- 2-week pilot sounds reasonable; we typically scope a focused deliverable (traces surfaced + one prompt-quality hook) rather than broad instrumentation.
- For keys/staging access we require a short security starter pack: SOC2 status, data retention expectations, and a list of endpoints that will call the Redwood API. If you can share that ahead of kickoff, we can speed onboarding.

We can meet Wed 3/15 at 11:30 PST — that works for Karthik and me. If that slot breaks for you, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Agenda suggestion for kickoff (30/60 min):
1) Introductions + success criteria
2) Scope of instrumentation (LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters, trace fields)
3) Environment/access needs + security checklist
4) Roles & owners (PilotPrompt vs Redwood)
5) Next steps / M.A.P. (mutual action plan)

Marissa — can you prepare a short SOW template and commercial guardrails for a 2-week co-eng (rough estimate, shared resources, and acceptance criteria)?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Alliances | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Mar 10, 2028 at 09:15 AM Alice Park <alice@pilotprompt.ai> wrote: (see above)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alice Park <alice@pilotprompt.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotPrompt x Redwood — proposal for a bilateral co-eng sprint

Appreciate the materials, Alice. A few operational notes ahead of the kickoff on Wed: 

Scope proposal (Redwood):
- Duration: 2-week co-eng with a single delivery milestone: "trace integration + one prompt-quality hook validated in staging".
- Acceptance criteria: traces for end-to-end requests visible in Redwood Console (no missing spans), total added p99 latency < 15ms, and prompt metadata surfaced for Optimize to consume.
- Ownership: PilotPrompt owns the adapter code; Redwood provides runtime hooks, test datasets, and a dedicated staging token. Post-pilot we can discuss maintenance and marketplace listing terms.

Security/compliance: Karthik — please confirm the minimum checklist (we typically require SOC2 summary, IP allowlist for staging, and a data-retention agreement). Alice — if you can share the SOC summary and endpoints ahead of Wed EOD that will unblock staging keys.

Commercially: we'll treat this as a pilot engagement (no charge) but reserve a short commercial review post-success to discuss go-to-market details. I've started a stub SOW in our shared Drive (link in the MAP).

Finally, legal/NDAs — I pinged legal to see if we need an NDA for exchanging ephemeral staging keys. If required, I'll share a quick mutual NDA template before the meeting.

See you Wed 11:30 PST.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of ISV Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gx-example-MAP]
